title: Bourgain's method for K-closedness in the semicommmutative setting
summary: In the early 1990s, J.Bourgain proved a general result $K$-closedness result in the context of classical harmonic analysis. In this paper, we extend Bourgain's method to the semicommutative setting, making use of the recent semicommutative Calderón-Zygmund decomposition introduced by L.Cadilhac, JM.Conde-Alonso and J.Parcet. As an application, we recover Pisier's result about $K$-closedness of noncommutative Hardy spaces on the torus, and we also establish new interpolation results for noncommutative Sobolev spaces on the torus.
